purpose: Three portrait proposals, not yet integrated into the book

variants.name: 01-photo-editoriale
variants.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: portrait illustration/photo asset for the personal introduction in Bible Strong World's digital book. Input image 1: reference photo and edit target. Preserve exactly the four family members, their recognizable faces, dark skin tones, ages, hairstyles, smiles and relative arrangement: woman left with dark sunglasses and olive green dress, man behind with round eyeglasses and white shirt holding baby right with yellow bib, smiling girl foreground with braids and yellow dress. Preserve affectionate natural poses and clothing. Portrait 3:4 composition, include all four faces with comfortable margins. No additional people, no lettering, no watermark, no book or UI mockup.
Primary request: create a polished natural photographic version of this exact family portrait suitable for a book. Style: authentic editorial family photography, lifelike and faithful, no beautification or facial redesign. Gently correct the strong orange lighting to soft natural daylight, preserve skin richness and natural skin texture. Simplify the distracting indoor background into a softly out-of-focus warm off-white interior. Keep the original mirror selfie phone and hands natural. Subtle fine film grain, restrained contrast, elegant and personal, not a glamour shoot.
